<div class="card-body">
'''Admiral Ozzel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オゼル提督</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の大型艦は同じ星系に－1で配備できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。場にベイダーが出ており、相手がオゼルと同じロケーションにリアクションで移動してきたなら、オゼル提督は即座にロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍を発見し壊滅させるために皇帝が編成したデス・スコードロンの<u>リーダー</u>。愚鈍で不器用。ダース・ベイダーに失策を露呈したばかりで、もはや失敗は許されない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Admiral Ozzel

'''Card text:''' Your capital starships may deploy at -1 to the same system. Adds 2 to the power of the starship he pilots. If Vader is on the table and the opponent moves to Ozzel's location as a react, Admiral Ozzel is immediately lost.

'''Lore:''' Leader of the Death Squadron formed by the Emperor to find and destroy the Rebels. Stupid and clumsy. Having just exposed his failure to Darth Vader, he can afford no further failures.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore expresses the English “next-to-last time” joke as allowing no further failures.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Ozzel]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
